incidents.narrative: 09.08.2026: 2210 UTC: Posn: 22:16.22N – 091:48.28E, Chittagong Port, Bangladesh A duty crew onboard a berthed tanker noticed around four to five individuals boarded their vessel. The individuals attacked on duty crew with stones and threatened another crew that approached. Alarm raised and crew mustered resulting the individuals escaped with stolen ship’s properties. Incident reported to the local authorities.
17.07.2026: 0630 UTC: Posn: 013:36.48N – 048:34.60E, Gulf of Aden While underway, a tanker was boarded and hijacked by pirates. Authorities are monitoring.

07.07.2026: 1539 UTC: Posn: 06:01.0S – 106:55.5E, Jakarta Anchorage, Indonesia Duty crew on board an anchored bulk carrier noticed ropes and a hook on the quarter deck and two unauthorised persons in the engine room. Alarm raised resulting in the unauthorised persons escaping with stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to Jakarta VTS and local agent.

05.07.2026: 0715 UTC: Posn: 14:24N – 042:44E, around 25nm SW of Hodeidah, Red Sea. Armed pirates in a skiff approached and fired upon a bulk carrier underway. The onboard armed security team returned fire, resulting in the skiff moving away and proceeding towards a suspected mothership. Vessel and crew reported safe.

04.07.2026: 2100 UTC: Posn: 01:11.8N – 103:25.1E, Singapore Straits Unnoticed robbers boarded a tanker underway and escaped with stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to the authorities. All crew reported safe.

01.07.2026: 0650 UTC: Posn: 12:47N – 048:02E, Gulf of Aden. Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier underway noticed a skiff with armed pirates approaching. Seeing the threat, master stopped the vessel, activated the distress alert, switched on the AIS and instructed all crew to retreat to the citadel. After a while, the crew exited the citadel. While no pirates were seen, the crew noticed the boarding ladders still rigged to the ship side resulting in the crew returning to the citadel as precaution. The Master's assessment indicated that four pirates had boarded the vessel and later departed. All crew reported safe.

29.06.2026: 2030 UTC: Posn: 02:51.41S – 122:13.76E, Bahodopi Anchorage, Indonesia Unnoticed robbers boarded an anchored bulk carrier and escaped with stolen ship's properties. The incident was reported to the authorities through the local agent.

22.06.2026: 0600 UTC: Posn: 03:55.1N – 098:47.3E, Belawan Anchorage, Indonesia. Duty officer onboard an anchored bulk carrier noticed several small boats near the forward of the vessel and notified the bosun to check. After several minutes, on not receiving any response from the bosun, the duty officer raised the alarm. Crew mustered and proceeded to the forecastle where they saw the bosun tied up. Seven robbers armed with knives were seen escaping from the forecastle store. On investigating ships properties were reported as stolen. Incident reported to Belawan VTS, Coast Guard and the local agent.

21.06.2026: 1012 UTC: Posn: 14:30.81N – 050:19.31E, Gulf of Aden. Five individuals armed with guns in a skiff approached and attempted to board a tanker underway. Alarm raised, crew mustered, speed increased and evasive manoeuvres executed resulting in the skiffs aborting the attempted boarding.
20.06.2026: 1900 UTC: Posn: 01:30.366N – 104:54.096E, Around 25nm NE of Berakit Island, Indonesia Three unauthorised persons boarded a barge under tow and escaped with stolen barge’s properties.

19.06.2026: 0015 UTC: Posn: Manila Anchorage, Philippines. Bosun onboard an anchored container ship noticed four robbers armed with a knife at the forecastle deck and immediately raised the alarm resulting in the robbers escaping with stolen ship’s properties.

18.06.2026: 1305 UTC: Posn: 11:59.5S – 077:13.4W Callao Anchorage, Peru. Unnoticed robbers boarded an anchored container ship, stole the ship’s properties and escaped. The theft was discovered the following morning.

15.06.2026: 0736 UTC: Posn: 13:10.8N – 046:27.9E, Gulf of Aden. Seven pirates armed with guns approached, fired upon and attempted to board a container vessel underway. Alarm raised, crew mustered, speed increased and evasive manoeuvres executed resulting in the pirates aborting the boarding attempt and moving away.

15.06.2026: 1350 UTC: Posn: 12:24.13N – 046:46.55E, Gulf of Aden. Seeing an approaching skiff, a tanker underway commenced evasive manoeuvres. As the skiff an RPG was fired towards the vessel which missed. The onboard armed security team returned fire resulting in the pirates aborting the approach and moving away.

12.06.2026: 0540 UTC: Posn: Manila North Port Anchorage, Philippines. Duty crew onboard an anchored container ship noticed an unauthorised person on the poop deck. Upon sighting the person escaped. The crew then noticed six robbers armed with a gun near the forward storeroom. On notifying the OOW, alarm raised, PA announcement made and crew mustered. Seeing the alerted crew the robbers escaped with stolen ship’s stores.

04.06.2026: 2006 UTC: Posn: 01:03.73N – 103:40.77E, Singapore Straits. Three robbers armed with a gun and knife boarded a bulk carrier under way and took hostage an engine crew while they stole engine spares. The crew reported the incident to the bridge after the robbers had escaped. Alarm raised, crew mustered and a search was carried out. VTIS Central informed. Upon anchoring the coast guard boarded the vessel for inspection. All crew safe.

03.06.2026: 2015 UTC: Posn: 14:36.6N – 120:49.0E, Manila Anchorage, Philippines. During routine rounds on an anchored container ship, the duty watchman was held at gunpoint by four robbers armed with three guns and a knife. The robbers forced him to open the bosun's store, tied his hands with rope, and escaped with stolen ship's stores. After freeing himself, the watchman alerted the OOW, who raised the general alarm and mustered the crew on the bridge. The incident was subsequently reported to the port authority.

12.05.2026: 1730 UTC: Posn: 01:03.05N – 103:38.06E, Singapore Straits. Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier underway noticed a robber armed with knives in the engine room workshop. The robber then threatened the duty crew who retreated in the engine control room and immediately informed the bridge. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the robber escaped. A search was carried out and all ship’s items accounted for. All crew reported safe.

02.05.2026: 0500 UTC: Posn: 13:49N – 048:28E, Around 12nm South of Qana Port Terminal, Shabwa, Yemen. Nine-armed persons boarded, hijacked, and took hostage the crew on an anchored tanker. Reports indicate the tanker to be heading towards the Somali Coast. Local and international Authorities are investigating.

THIS IS A SUSPICIOUS INCIDENT AND WILL NOT FEATURE IN THE STATISTICS 28.04.2026: 1315 UTC: Posn: 03:15.3N – 056:24.2E, Around 478NM ESE of Garacad, Somalia. Crew onboard a tanker underway noticed a suspected mother vessel and a skiff approaching from different directions. Suspecting the approach to be potential pirate tactic, Master raised the alarm, increased speed, executed evasive manoeuvres, and the onboard security personnel displayed their weapons. At the distance of around 400 meters the skiff aborted the approach and moved away. Crew and vessel safe.

27.04.2026: 0358 UTC: Posn: 04:40.75N – 006:36.06W, San Pedro Anchorage, Ivory Coast. Unauthorised persons attempted to gain access to an anchored container vessel via its anchor chain and on hearing the ship's alarm aborted the attempt and fled in a wooden boat. Authorities have been notified.

26.04.2026: Posn: 07:13N – 049:32E, around 20NM NNE of Garacad, Somalia While underway, a cargo vessel was boarded and hijacked by armed persons. The incident is ongoing and being monitored by Authorities.

25.04.2026: 1601 to 2000 UTC: Posn: 05:49.1N – 118:08.1E, Sandakan Anchorage, Malaysia. During routine rounds, duty crew onboard an anchored tanker noticed ship’s properties missing. On reporting the theft to local authorities, the coastguard and marine police boarded the vessel for inspection.
25.04.2026: Posn: around 10nm off Dhinowda, Somalia. The dhow reported of being hijacked was released on 04 May 26. All crew reported safe.

23.04.2026: 0720 UTC: Posn: 06:23.80N – 049:49.1E, Around 43nm SE of Garacad, Somalia. Members of an armed security team onboard a general cargo ship underway noticed a skiff approaching rapidly. Alarm raised, speed increased, crew mustered in a safe place and the armed team took their positions. At a distance of around 600m meters there was an exchange of fire between the four pirates on the skiff and the armed team, resulting in the pirates aborting and moving away. All crew members are reported safe and unharmed.

21.04.2026: 1140UTC: Posn: 08:56.31N – 050:32.84E, around 6NM SSW of Durdura, Somalia While underway, a tanker was boarded and hijacked by 30 persons armed with RPG and AK47s. The incident is ongoing and being monitored by Authorities.

19.04.2026: 0200 UTC: Posn: 01:08.23N – 103:28.63E, Singapore Straits. Two unauthorised persons boarded a barge under tow. Nearby vessels alerted the tug master who boarded the barge for inspection resulting in the persons escaping. It was reported that a container onboard the barge was broken into and contents stolen. Incident reported to the local authorities.

15.04.2026: 1800 UTC: Posn: 02:51.7S – 122:13.7E, Bahodopi Anchorage, Indonesia During routine rounds, duty crew onboard an anchored bulk carrier noticed the forward sky light open and on further checking it was discovered that ship’s property had been stolen. The incident was reported to the port control.

08.04.2026: 1940 UTC: Posn: 01:03.0N – 103:39.7E, Singapore Straits. Four robbers armed with a gun and long knife boarded a bulk carrier underway and entered the engine room. They threatened the duty oiler who retreated to a safe location and raised the alarm. Hearing the alarm the robbers escaped with stolen ships engine spares. The incident was reported to VTS and Singapore Police Coast Guard boarded the vessel for investigation.

28.03.2026: 0700 UTC: Posn: 14:35.65N – 120:51.70E, Manila Anchorage, Philippines. Duty crew on an anchored container ship noticed three unauthorised individuals on board and raised the alarm. Seeing the alerted crew the individuals jumped overboard and escaped. No theft was reported.

25.03.2026: 0834 UTC: Posn: Around 400nm East of Mogadishu, Somalia. An Iranian dhow was hijacked by pirates and potentially used as a mothership. EUNAVFOR OP ATALANTA closely monitored the situation and, in coordination with Somali authorities, disrupted the Pirate Action Group (PAG) and freed the hijacked dhow on 06 April 2026. All crew members are reported safe.

18.03.2026: 1945 UTC: Posn: 01:02.9N - 103:37.7E, Singapore Straits. Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier underway noticed four persons armed with knives in the engine room. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the persons escaped with stolen ship’s engine spares and properties. The incident was reported to VTIS, who instructed the vessel to proceed to the anchorage for inspection by the Coast Guard.

18.03.2026: 1755 UTC: Posn: 01:03.6N – 103:37.60E, Singapore Straits. Unauthorized individuals boarded a bulk carrier underway and managed to enter the engine room. They encountered the 3rd Engineer who was on duty, and he promptly alerted the bridge. The general alarm was sounded, and the intruders left the ship. The 3rd Engineer suffered a minor head injury and received medical attention on shore. The incident was reported to VTIS, and the Police Coast Guard inspected the ship before bunkering.

17.03.2026: 1740 UTC: Posn: 01:04.0N - 103:36.3E, Singapore Straits. Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier underway identified one unauthorised person boarding via the starboard quarter. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, four unauthorised persons were seen escaping. Incident reported to VTIS West and Singapore Police Coast Guard boarded the vessel for inspection.

06.03.2026: 1900 UTC: Posn: 01:02.3N - 103:40.2E, Singapore Straits. Seven unauthorised persons armed with knives boarded a tanker underway and entered the engine room. Alarm raised, public address announcement made, crew mustered, and a search was conducted. Incident reported to VTIS and Singapore Coast Guard who then escorted the vessel. All crew safe and nothing reported stolen.

27.02.2026: 1840 UTC: Posn: 01:05.7N – 103:33.0E, Singapore Straits. Duty engine crew onboard a bulk carrier underway noticed three robbers, armed with a knife in the engine room. Alarm raised, PA announcement made and crew mustered. On searching the vessel, no robbers identified and all ship’s items accounted for. The incident was reported to VTIS and the vessel was instructed to proceed to the designated anchorage for further investigations. All crew reported safe.

26.02.2026: 1830 UTC: Posn: 01:02.70N – 103:38.60E, Singapore Straits. Five robbers in a small wooden boat approached and boarded a bulk carrier underway. They went into the engine room and held the duty oiler hostage, threatening him with a gun and a machete. They demanded to know the location of the engine workshop and took the oiler's flashlight and phone. The robbers told the oiler to stay in the workshop while they searched for valuable items. When an engine alarm went off, the oiler ran to the Engine Control Room, locked himself in, and alerted the OOW. Alarm raised, public announcement made, VTIS informed, and a distress message broadcast. A Singapore navy vessel arrived and conducted a search of the vessel with the crew. No robbers were found.

26.02.2026: 1833 UTC: Posn: 08:27N – 050:34E, Around 15.5nm ESE of Garmaal, Somalia. Suspected pirates in two skiffs approached and attempted to board a vessel underway. The vessel implemented defensive measures, resulting in the skiffs aborting the attempted boarding. It was reported that one suspected pirate was killed and two others injured during the incident. No further information is available.

19.02.2026: 1954 UTC: Posn: 14:36.68N - 120:49.64E, Manila Anchorage, Philippines. During a security round, duty crew onboard an anchored container ship observed that the hawse pipe cover had been opened. Alarm raised, crew mustered and a search was carried out. It was discovered that ship’s property had been stolen. The incident was reported to Manila VTS and the Coast Guard, who later boarded the vessel to carry out an investigation.

02.02.2026: 1530 UTC: Posn: 04:15.1S – 152:11.1E, Port Rabaul Anchorage, Papua New Guinea. Robbers in a canoe, armed with machetes approached an anchored container ship. Duty The crew spotted one robber on deck and immediately raised the alarm. All crew members were instructed to remain inside the accommodation area and secure all access doors. Port authorities contacted but no response received. The incident was also reported to the local agent to notify the authorities. Two life rafts were stolen. The following morning, patrol boats arrived and recovered one of the life rafts, which was opened and unusable. Upon docking, Customs Border Protection officials boarded the ship for further investigations.

27.01.2026: 2140 UTC: Posn: 04:53.1N – 001:39.7W, Takoradi Anchorage, Ghana. Duty crew on routine rounds onboard an anchored bulk carrier heard voices from the paint store and immediately informed the bridge. Fog horn sounded and port control notified. Seeing the alerted crews, the persons escaped with stolen ship’s stores in a small boat. Port control dispatched a patrol boat to the vessel for investigation.

26.01.2026: 1300 UTC: Posn: 14:33.0N - 120:49.7E, Manila Anchorage, Philippines. Six robbers armed with knives boarded an anchored container ship. They locked a patrolling crew member inside the bosun’s store. The crew member later managed to free himself and raised the alarm. Upon hearing the alarm, the robbers escaped with stolen ship’s properties.

19.01.2026: 0640 UTC: Posn: 01:14.86N – 104:03.39E, Singapore Straits. Fourteen individuals in six boats approached a laden barge under towed. Eight individuals boarded the barge, stole some scrap metals cargo, and transferred it to their boats. The Captain notified VTIS, changed course towards Malaysian waters, resulting in the individuals moving away. The vessel then resumed its journey.

16.01.2026: 1954 UTC: Posn: 01:04.2N – 103:40.7E, Singapore Straits. Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier noticed six robbers armed with knives in the engine room. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the robbers escaped with stolen ship’s engine spares. The incident was reported to VTIS, who instructed the vessel to proceed to the anchorage for inspection by the Coast Guard.

15.01.2026: 2130 UTC: Posn: 13:45.7N – 120:58.4E, Bauan Anchorage, Batangas Bay, Philippines. Unauthorized individuals boarded an anchored bulk carrier and escaped with ship’s properties. The theft was discovered by the duty crew on routine rounds. The coast guard was informed and they boarded the ship for inspection.

03.01.2026: 1550 UTC: Posn: 13:45.72N – 120:59.59E, Bauan Anchorage, Batangas Bay, Philippines. The Philippine Coast Guard intercepted an individual in a motorbanca carrying suspicious items during a maritime patrol. Upon investigation, they discovered additional individuals on an anchored Ro-Ro ship. Additional coast guard personnel were deployed to the ship, resulting in the apprehension of four individuals. All five individuals were taken to the Coast Guard office for further investigation.
